workload: simclrv2 (imagenette2 train, 9,469 records; captures use 600-900 records per plan)
question: affine kx+b 在真实重排计划上的迁移误差来自哪里，能否用有依据的剖析/建模修复

frozen_before_validation: fit protocol: two-stratum (smallest/largest) linear fit, k and b by least squares through the two points
size features compared: serialized bytes (M2) vs elements C*H*W (M3), plus per-representation-class coefficients (M4)
the middle spatial scale (244) is never used for fitting; it is the held-out point
validation plans v1, v2 are linear extensions of the feature DAG that the diagnosis never used
per-cell estimator: p10 over interleaved rounds inside one process; means are reported but not used as the correctness target
stopping rule: one capture run per plan (600-900 records, 4 local workers) plus 21 interleaved rounds for the operator matrix
exploratory_before_freeze: the four diagnosis plans (declared, pico, cedar, old-dp) and all per-operator error tables
the discovery of the heavy-tailed in-pipeline per-call distribution and of the instrumentation pitfall of thread settings
pre_registration.honesty_note: 协议是在诊断阶段之后、v1/v2 验证之前冻结的。诊断数据用于提出问题与设计模型，v1/v2 只用于验证，未参与任何拟合。

models.M2_affine_bytes: cost = k_bytes * bytes + b_bytes; k,b from physical_model.operator_affine of the shared layered profile
models.M3_affine_elements: cost = k_el * elements + b_el; one pair per operator, fitted on the declared plan's own payload
models.M4_affine_representation: cost = k_(op,class) * elements + b_(op,class); class = {uint8,float32} x {1ch,3ch}

targets.primary: in-pipeline per-call p10 summed over the priced operators (reproducible service time)
targets.secondary: in-pipeline per-call median and mean (mean contains an unexplained heavy tail; reported but not used for model validation)

plans.pipe_ids: 0 batcher, 1 normalize, 2 blur, 3 grayscale, 4 jitter, 5 flip, 6 crop, 7 to_float, 8 image reader, 9 lister

legality.caveat: legal plans are not augmentation-equivalent: ColorJitter loses its saturation/hue work on 1-channel input, and Grayscale before crop changes what is resized and blurred

stop_rules: no model parameter is fitted on a validation plan
no operator or plan is dropped because the model does poorly on it
if the reproducible (p10) estimator disagreed between the two interleaved blocks by more than 20%, the cell was to be re-measured; none exceeded 2% in the reported run

run_20260924_repr_model.question: 把计算模型从 serialized bytes 换成 elements + representation class，是否改进算子与计划成本预测、并影响优化器选择

frozen_before_validation: fit protocol: per (operator, representation class) two-stratum fit in ELEMENTS, spatial 0.5x/2.0x only
each point measured with a 5 s real-call budget inside one interleaved window per operator
models M1 proportional bytes, M2 byte affine, M3 element affine (declared class), M4 representation-aware proportional, M5 representation-aware affine
primary target: mean per-call operator self time inside complete runs (three complete runs per plan)
validation plans: the 11 captured plans (6 cast-position, 3 diagnosis, 2 held-out orders), none used for fitting
missing representation classes must be reported and never silently priced by the byte model
acceptance: DP must match brute force over all legal orders under the boundary-free objective
exploratory: the profile generation itself was re-run with the new section; the byte-affine part changed by ~30% because it is a fresh measurement
stage B uses 1 epoch (9,469 records) instead of the campaign's 20 epochs to keep the cell runnable

semantic_scope.finding: no legal reorder of this feature is augmentation-equivalent: moving to_float changes how torchvision interprets the payload range (float images are clamped to [0,1])
semantic_scope.consequence: throughput differences between plans are reported as plan-choice effects, not as equivalent optimization gains

stop_rules: no model parameter fitted on any validation plan
no plan or operator dropped because a model does poorly on it
if a decisive negative result appears (as with the semantic-equivalence check), the corresponding experiment line is stopped and reported
